meta.note: q(x_t) is the truth scaled and blurred, so every number here that calls itself exact is a closed form or a quadrature on a box sized for that noise level, never an average over samples

ink.note: the judge is known to score ink (see the energy based article); this is that test re-run on THESE pools, and a ranking may only be published when `confounded` is false

ddpm.why_no_exact: the reverse chain has no closed form density, so this article cannot put a number in the column the flow filled exactly and the autoencoder bounded; what it has is samples
